items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: And Danny Lewis went crazy. Danny Lewis.

ctx.x: He didn't have, nobody told me that ever. Yeah, Frank. How do you see him? Frank Lewis went crazy.

Frank Lewis went crazy. Oh, Frank Lewis. Frank Lewis went crazy. And Danny Lewis went crazy. Danny Lewis. Yeah. See, JSP, JSP, Jimmy Johnson. Jimmy Johnson would play with my uncle Wilder on there. He was the one that Bowling band. See? Because Bowling was an uptown band. That's right. Up there around, up there around Media Street, all the way around Fertown. See? Well, Eagle band and them bands of town, we didn't class them bands as nothing. Now, them bands we didn't class as nothing back in those days. It was…
